report_name: Medusa Ransomware Victim Count Surpasses 500, US Agencies Warn

threat_actors.name: Medusa
threat_actors.description: A ransomware operation that evolved from a private group to a public Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) platform in early 2023. The group opportunistically targets organizations with known, unpatched vulnerabilities, with a notable focus on the healthcare sector, and uses a double-extortion model.
threat_actors.goals: Financial extortion through ransomware deployment and data exfiltration.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: Used for initial access by exploiting unpatched software and known vulnerabilities in public-facing applications.

attack_patterns.name: Remote Access Software
attack_patterns.description: Legitimate remote monitoring and management (RMM) tools are used for persistence and command and control, blending in with normal administrative activity.

attack_patterns.name: PowerShell
attack_patterns.description: Leveraged for execution of commands and lateral movement within the compromised network.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: Sensitive data is stolen and exfiltrated before encryption as part of a double-extortion tactic.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The primary objective of deploying the Medusa ransomware payload to encrypt files across the victim's network.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: Actors disable recovery capabilities by deleting backups and shadow copies, a behavior for which specific command patterns like 'vssadmin.exe delete shadows' are recommended for monitoring.

malware.name: Medusa
malware.description: A ransomware payload deployed by the Medusa RaaS group to encrypt files on a victim's network. The payload is often named 'gaze.exe'.

tools.name: vssadmin
tools.description: Used to delete volume shadow copies to inhibit system recovery.

indicators.name: Medusa Ransomware Payload Filename
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Medusa Ransomware Payload Execution by Filename
id: 2b8c1d9e-4f5a-4b6c-8d9e-0f1a2b3c4d5e
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of a process with the filename 'gaze.exe', a known payload name for Medusa ransomware.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-21
references:
  - https://www.esecurityplanet.com/cybersecurity/news-medusa-ransomware-500-victims-rapid-exploitation/
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.impact
level: critical
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\gaze.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of 'gaze.exe', a known filename for the Medusa ransomware payload.

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: f8a1b2c3-d4e5-4f6a-7b8c-9d0e1f2a3b4c
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware technique to inhibit system recovery.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-21
references:
  - https://www.esecurityplanet.com/cybersecurity/news-medusa-ransomware-500-victims-rapid-exploitation/
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a technique associated with Medusa ransomware to inhibit system recovery.

indicators.name: Suspicious Encoded PowerShell Command
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Encoded PowerShell Command
id: 1c2d3e4f-5a6b-4c7d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f
status: experimental
description: 'Detects the use of encoded commands in PowerShell (powershell.exe -enc), a common obfuscation technique used by threat actors like Medusa.'
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-21
references:
  - https://www.esecurityplanet.com/cybersecurity/news-medusa-ransomware-500-victims-rapid-exploitation/
tags:
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.execution
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 
      - ' -enc '
      - ' -encodedcommand '
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of encoded PowerShell commands, a common TTP for Medusa to obfuscate its activity.
